column8: ["Give the broad teal housing more worked ceramic detail: pooled glaze, fine crazing and rubbed edges would make its large surfaces rewarding to inspect.","Sharpen the brass crescent with distinct bevels, dark recesses and selective polished glints; it currently reads as a soft brown groove.","Clarify the circular opening with a firmer inner wall and layered material edges so it feels built into a thick casting.","Introduce a few characterful fittings or visible joins, with worn rubber and fastening details that make this feel like a machine somebody assembled."]
